overall_assessment.decision_summary: All applicable control points were verified as MATCH. The certificate was verified against the two separate invoice files; embedded invoice copies in the certificate file were not used as independent verification evidence. Quantity was verified by exact summation across the two invoice files.
overall_assessment.human_explanation: Certifikatet och de två bifogade fakturorna avser samma avsändare, mottagare, vara och ursprung. Kvantiteterna i certifikatet, 39 960 kg netto och 42 300 kg brutto, verifieras genom summering av de två fakturorna som vardera visar 19 980 kg netto och 21 150 kg brutto. Dokumenten kan därför godkännas automatiskt.
